Please find attached the reports of
• RML Offline Devices > 14 days under Production Sites. These devices must be powered on to prevent being locked.
• RML Offline Devices > 44 days under Production Sites. These devices must be powered on to avoid being data-wiped.

After a device is locked or wiped, if it is located, please raise an incident with the Zebra PDA Service Desk L1 to unlock or request a replacement if it is wiped. A file will only be attached if there is data to report for that category.
